scope_note: Explicit input manifest. The builder reads ONLY the files named here and refuses to run if any declared sha256 mismatches. Nothing is discovered by globbing and nothing is inferred from a filename. Facts that exist only in prose are transcribed as curated_observations carrying evidence_path, evidence_sha256 and a verbatim evidence_quote. Unknown facts are null, never guessed.
